g.text: x86_64 Linux · ncnn · one CPU thread per model · mono 16,000 Hz · eight synthetic wake/command pairs
All model assets: 11.29 MiB. Five-session load: 645.7 ms. Whole Python process peak RSS: 197.2 MiB.
Complete budget includes wake, all scheduled previews, final VCM, VAD and speaker checks; it excludes elapsed audio, endpoint waiting,
file decoding, worker IPC, UI and actions. It measures serial compute, not live user latency. Physical Pi performance remains unmeasured.
